notes: Monthly vapour-pressure ratios (ISD station hourly dew points ÷ Daymet vp over the days both report, 2011–2025), from scripts/climate-data/station-humidity.ts; applied by generate.ts before relative humidity is derived.

Station: the nearest ISD station within 40 km and 300 m of the anchor with at least 5 usable years (its vapour pressure moved to the pixel elevation with a 2.5 km scale height); airports preferred over tide-gauge sensors; up to two missing months filled by interpolation.
Not corrected: Ojai (only fog-coast stations across the hills), Marquette (tide-gauge sensor only), Puerto Vallarta (8 months missing), and places with no station in range.
